name: Whirlpool Connected Smart Gen III Current Transformer
purpose: Verify CT winding at PM board J4 per W10785366A §4-17 (135 Ω ±5%).
failureModes: Open (OL): CT or harness fault — live power measurement unavailable in app
Out of range: damaged CT or internal harness
testingTips: Disconnect J4 from PM board before measuring
CT1: J4 pins 1 & 2; CT2 (L2 appliances): J4 pins 3 & 4
Black face of CT toward power source; clamp on L1 (washer) or at terminal block (dryer)
notes: 135 Ω ±5% for CT1 and CT2 when appliance uses L2 (electric dryer)

name: Whirlpool Connected Smart Gen III WiFi Module +5 VDC
purpose: WiFi processor module supply at J4-1 (+5 VDC) to J4-6 (GND) per W10785366A §4-14 step 6.
failureModes: Missing 5 VDC: harness or control board supply fault
Present but module LED off: replace WiFi module after harness check
testingTips: Live measurement — controls off, allow ~1 min after power-up
Voltage may read higher per appliance tech sheet
notes: Common cross-category WiFi module; J4 WIDE/WIN connector

name: Whirlpool Connected Smart Gen III PM Board +5 VDC
purpose: Power Management board WIDE/WIN supply at J2-1 (+5 VDC) to J2-3 (GND); J3 interchangeable per manual.
failureModes: Missing 5 VDC: harness between PM board and control
5 VDC OK but no live kW in app: suspect CT or PM board replacement
testingTips: Perform CT Ω checks with power off before live 5 VDC test
Washer/dryer only — dishwasher and refrigerator omit PM board
